learning_objective: 📐 Discover the 'Principles of Design'—the secret rules artists use to arrange visual elements so they look balanced, exciting, and beautiful!

key_vocabulary.hindi_meaning: संयोजन (कला के तत्वों को कैनवास पर व्यवस्थित करने का तरीका)
संतुलन (कलाकृति में दृश्य भार (Visual weight) को समान रूप से बांटना)
प्रधानता (दर्शकों का ध्यान खींचने वाला मुख्य बिंदु या केंद्र)
अनुपात (एक वस्तु का दूसरी वस्तु के सापेक्ष आकार)
लय (आँखों को एक दिशा से दूसरी दिशा में ले जाने वाली गति)

main_concepts.simple_explanation: If the 'Elements of Art' (line, color, shape) are the ingredients, the 'Principles of Design' are the recipe. Composition is how the artist arranges those ingredients within the frame to make the artwork look complete and pleasing.

Visual balance prevents art from looking lopsided. Symmetrical balance is like a mirror (identical on both sides). Asymmetrical balance uses different objects of equal visual weight (e.g., one large dark circle on the left balanced by three small light circles on the right).

This is the spot where the artist wants you to look first. They create emphasis by using contrast (a bright red apple in a black-and-white room) or by making lines point directly toward the most important object.

Proportion relates to the size of parts within a whole (like drawing a head the right size for a body). Scale is the size of an object compared to the real world (drawing a giant mouse next to a tiny elephant creates a surreal scale).

Rhythm is created by repeating elements (like a row of trees). It creates 'Movement', guiding the viewer's eye smoothly across the painting. 'Unity' happens when all the elements feel like they belong together, making the art feel complete.

fun_activity.title: 📱 The Rule of Thirds
fun_activity.instructions: Open the camera on your phone and turn on the 'Grid' feature (it makes a tic-tac-toe board). Instead of putting your subject exactly in the center, try placing them where the lines cross. This basic composition rule makes photos look instantly more professional!

exam_tips: 📌 Distinguish between the 'Elements of Art' (the basic tools: line, shape, color) and the 'Principles of Design' (how to use the tools: balance, rhythm, emphasis).
📌 Explain how Asymmetrical Balance works using the concept of 'Visual Weight' (e.g., color, size, or texture can make an object feel heavier).
📌 Contrast is the easiest way to create Emphasis (Focal Point) in a composition.
quick_recap: ⭐ Composition is the structural layout of an artwork.
⭐ Radial balance is when elements radiate outwards from a central point, like the petals of a daisy or a mandala.
⭐ A successful composition guides the viewer's eye exactly where the artist wants it to go.
